summary: Lincoln County lookout on Otter Crest near Depoe Bay: two stations built in 1936, a 1938 removal and a 1940 live-in tower give conflicting timelines; marked gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts ties construction to the 1936 association report (two stations, one on Otter Crest). Firelookout.com dates a live-in tower to 1940. Both dates appear in the story and the editor should choose one for the infobox.
Forest Lookouts lists the lookout as removed around 1938. Firelookout.com says it was abandoned in the 1940s. The story reports both and does not pick one.
Firelookout.com credits the Oregon Department of Forestry. Forest Lookouts cites Lincoln County FPA annual reports. Both are recorded.

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on the timeline: the 1936 build and 1938 removal (Forest Lookouts) against a 1940 live-in tower abandoned in the 1940s (firelookout.com). No source describes what remains at the site. The Look-Out building (ARG) is a separate 1937 coffee shop and gift shop beside the Otter Crest viewpoint; no source links it to the fire lookout site. The ARG page is undated, so the 'next spring' reopening cannot be dated. The brief's elevation is not in the facts schema and was left out (firelookout.com gives 420 ft; a Lincoln County index snippet gives 1,200 but was not read on a page). Corrections: none proposed.
